N = 10
new_data = ((N+1)*data)/(N*data + 1)

im = plt.imshow(
    new_data,
    cmap="viridis",
    origin="upper",
    aspect="auto"
)

plt.colorbar(im, label="Value")
plt.xlabel("Column Index")
plt.ylabel("Row Index")
plt.title("2D Matrix Heatmap")

plt.xticks(np.arange(data.shape[1]))
plt.yticks(np.arange(data.shape[0]))
